transcript: Okay, so I ranked the Modern Green Utopia first because I feel like it's more, it's the most future forward, it's practical and it's conserving of resources while also making sure that everyone gets what they need. um the primitivist utopia i rank second because i just think i would enjoy that um because there's less technology and you're not having to worry about a huge society and all the problems with different groups you just have your group um and it's low stakes and there's a big sense of community um moral commonwealth is third because i think it would be really cool but i'm not sure if it would be sustainable or realistic um institutional utopia rule of law i feel like that's kind of how america is right now and i mean it keeps people safe for the most part um but you lose a bit of autonomy um the futurist utopia is fifth because i didn't like that they continued to make new things even if it wasn't smart given the lack of resources um and i also think that at some point you gotta just chill a little bit um religious utopia i put sixth um because i'm not religious and i just think that blind faith it can be protective in some ways, but it's also naive. Then last I put the AI centered utopia because it takes humans completely out of the situation.
